package module

import (
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
)

func normalizeModuleTranslations(entries []domain.ModuleI18n) []domain.ModuleI18n {
	seen := make(map[int]struct{})
	result := make([]domain.ModuleI18n, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.I18nID <= 0 {
			continue
		}
		entry.Title = strings.TrimSpace(entry.Title)
		entry.Description = strings.TrimSpace(entry.Description)
		if entry.Title == "" || entry.Description == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := seen[entry.I18nID]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[entry.I18nID] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, entry)
	}
	return result
}

func isValidModuleVisibility(visibility int) bool {
	switch visibility {
	case domain.ModuleVisibilityCourseOnly,
		domain.ModuleVisibilityStandalone,
		domain.ModuleVisibilityBoth,
		domain.ModuleVisibilityInternal:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
